target.title: fix(clickclack): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
Related: #90684

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where assistant internal tool-trace scaffolding — `<tool_call>`-style XML blocks and `⚠️ 🛠️ … failed` tool banners, among the scaffolding forms `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText()` strips — leaks verbatim into ClickClack chat whenever it appears in the assistant's reply text.

`sanitizeAssistantVisibleText()` exists for exactly this, but the ClickClack outbound adapter never declares the `sanitizeText` hook, so core delivery sends the raw text through.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is the ClickClack sibling of the per-channel fixes tracked under #90684 — the same adapter hook pattern was merged for Twitch yesterday, with the earlier sibling channels linked from that issue. ClickClack is the remaining bundled chat adapter in this family without an open PR.

The fix adds the family-standard hook to the plugin's `outbound.base`:

```ts
sanitizeText: ({ text }) => sanitizeAssistantVisibleText(text),
```

ClickClack composes its outbound adapter from `base` plus attached-result send functions; the base is spread into the final adapter, so core delivery picks the hook up and applies it before chunk planning, the same as for the directly-declared sibling adapters.

This change is limited to text delivered through core outbound delivery (the channel's normal reply path); send paths that do not go through core outbound delivery are unchanged.

## User Impact

ClickClack users no longer see internal tool-call XML or tool-failure banners in chat when a model leaks scaffolding into its reply text. Ordinary assistant prose is delivered unchanged. No config, schema, or API changes.

## Evidence

Boundary capture drives the composed production plugin object (`clickClackPlugin.outbound.sanitizeText` — the adapter core delivery reads after base composition) under `node --import tsx`; no sanitizer or plugin code is faked. A live ClickClack send is not exercised (infeasible here).

```
                        input                                              before (no hook)                        after (hook)
tool banner             "Done.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed"       passes through verbatim                 "Done."
XML tool_call leak      "<tool_call>{...}</tool_call>Deploy finished."     passes through verbatim                 "Deploy finished."
ordinary prose          "The pipeline has 3 open deals."                   "The pipeline has 3 open deals."        unchanged
```

(The `before` column is captured with the production change removed — the composed adapter then exposes no `sanitizeText` hook and both leak cases pass through raw. The `after` column is captured at this PR's HEAD.)

Focused regression tests (`extensions/clickclack/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts`, 4 cases) assert through the composed plugin object: the hook survives base composition, tool banner stripped, XML `<tool_call>` block stripped, ordinary prose preserved. All 4 fail without the production change.

Local (worktree at this PR's HEAD):

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts` — 4/4
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack` — 56/56
- `oxfmt` / `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` on the two touched files — clean
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — clean

`check:changed` lanes run on CI.
